First stable release. The major version stays 0.

This is the v1 scope that is on main: a two-screen home, collections, Find, multi-select, RomM, play tracking, and the bundled plugins. It is not a Thor hardware pass.

### Home
The bottom screen is the grid. The top screen shows the selected game. Each system and source has its own folder. Press A to play on the top screen, or X to play on the bottom. Azahar and melonDS take both screens. While one screen is in a game, the other can show a dim command center.

### Collections
Collections are separate from those folders. Name one from the controller, pick a color and a glyph, and put a game in as many as you want. Pin a game to Home, favorite it, or hide it. Favorites and Recently played show up on Home when you have something to put there. Hide, unpin, remove, and tidy can be undone.

### Find and multi-select
Select opens Find. A few letters are enough, and an empty query lists what you played last. Y, then Select, checks several tiles. Add them to a collection, pin them, favorite them, or hide them in one step.

### Libraries and plugins
One home holds local folders, a RomM server, installed Android games and apps, Moonlight shortcuts, DroidDeck, and GameNative Steam games exported as `.steam` files. Foldcade also launches the installed emulators it recognizes, including Azahar for 3DS and melonDS for DS.

RomM signs in with a code, lists that server's catalog, and downloads a game when you launch it. Save sync in this release is melonDS `.sav` files with RomM 5.4.0 or newer. Offline changes wait, and a conflict keeps both copies. Azahar title-save transfer is not in this release. Save states are not synced.

### Play tracking
Foldcade records how long you played and when. The L1 menu shows the week. All can be sorted by recent play, and Settings can count sessions that started outside Foldcade.

### Look
The Afterglow theme ships in the app: true black, neon tiles, and optional motion. Lanternlight, the original home track, plays while you browse and fades when a game launches.

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- Download progress is still an open gap. `ensureLocal` returns when the copy is ready and has no progress channel. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/11
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
